Withdrawals before age 59.5 normally incur a 10% penalty in addition to income tax. Exception: a hardship withdrawal is penalty-free if it is for (a) eligible medical expenses exceeding 7.5% of adjusted gross income, or (b) preventing eviction or foreclosure on a primary residence, with documentation.
